tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version numbering scheme

This project's current recorded decision is to use semantic versioning (semver, `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`) for release versions: a major increment signals breaking changes, a minor increment signals new backward-compatible features, and a patch increment signals backward-compatible bug fixes. The rationale on record is that signaling API compatibility to consumers matters more than signaling release publication dates.
EOF
cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md
